source: sars-guide:PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Rev 1 p. 28 (non-standard employment, at least 5 hours per day, earns less than R394 that day: no employees tax)
notes: Non-standard employment (casual, under 22 hours a week, no declaration), 5 hours a day at R390 a day for 22 days = R8 580. The daily pay is under R394, so no employees' tax (G21 p. 28, summary table row 3). The tables would tax it (x12 = 102 960, 18% = 18 532.80, less 17 820 = 712.80, /12 = 59.40), so the calculator is wrong. Only PAYE is asserted: UIF/SDL for casual workers are not given by this table.
